info.description:
REST API of the Transaction Processing System (TPS): accounts, double-entry ledger, transfers and payments through simulated providers. Errors follow RFC 9457 (Problem Details); see the API conventions in the repository.

Authentication: obtain a token with `POST /api/v1/auth/tokens`, then click **Authorize** and paste it.

license.name: Portfolio project, not for real funds

info.title: TPS API

get.description: Sorted by name. documentNumber finds a holder by its document, with or without dashes. Requires ACCOUNT_READ.

post.description: A person (DNI, RTN or passport) or a business (RTN). One holder per identity document. Requires ACCOUNT_MANAGE.

get.description: Sorted by account number. Optional filters: holderId, status, accountNumber. Requires ACCOUNT_READ.

post.description: Opens an ACTIVE account with a zero balance and a new 12-digit account number. Requires ACCOUNT_MANAGE.

get.description: Ledger balance (all posted movements) and available balance (minus funds on hold; equal for now). Requires ACCOUNT_READ.
get.summary: Get the balance of an account

get.description: Newest first, with the balance after each movement. CREDIT is money in, DEBIT money out. Requires ACCOUNT_READ.
get.summary: List the movements of an account

put.description: ACTIVE ⇄ SUSPENDED, and ACTIVE or SUSPENDED → CLOSED. Closing is final and requires a zero balance. The reason is stored in the status history. Requires ACCOUNT_MANAGE.
put.summary: Change the status of an account

get.description: Newest first; the oldest entry is the opening. Requires ACCOUNT_READ.
get.summary: List the status history of an account

post.description: Exchanges a username and password for an access token (JWT). Any failure returns 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS without saying why. Too many consecutive failures lock the account temporarily.

The account must be ACTIVE and in the given currency. Responses: 201 with the transaction when it completes; 422 Problem Details with the rule's code (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, ACCOUNT_CLOSED, CURRENCY_MISMATCH) and the transactionId when it is rejected. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key gets the same response plus `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Requires DEPOSIT_EXECUTE.

parameters.description: Unique per operation: generate one (a UUID is recommended) and send it again, unchanged, when retrying. A retry returns the first result instead of moving money twice.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

get.description: Internal and customer accounts of the books, sorted by code. Requires LEDGER_READ.
Newest first, with the balance after each posting. Requires LEDGER_READ.
get.summary: List the postings of a ledger account

get.description: With all its lines. Requires LEDGER_READ.
Recomputes every balance from the postings and checks that every journal entry is balanced and that total debits equal total credits in each currency. Scans the whole ledger. Requires LEDGER_READ.
Newest first, completed and rejected alike. Optional filters: accountId (money in or out of that account), type, status. Requires TRANSACTION_READ.
Every status it went through, oldest first; the first entry is its creation. Requires TRANSACTION_READ.
get.summary: Get the status history of a transaction

put.description: Requires USER_MANAGE. Not allowed on yourself, nor if it would leave no active administrator. Takes effect at the user's next login.
Requires USER_MANAGE. ACTIVE also unlocks a temporarily locked account. Not allowed on yourself, nor if it would leave no active administrator.

post.description: The account must be ACTIVE, in the given currency, and have the funds. Responses: 201 with the transaction when it completes; 422 Problem Details with the rule's code (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS, ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED, ACCOUNT_CLOSED, CURRENCY_MISMATCH) and the transactionId when it is rejected. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key gets the same response plus `Idempotent-Replayed: true`; the same key with a different body is 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. Requires WITHDRAWAL_EXECUTE.

parameters.description: Unique per operation: generate one (a UUID is recommended) and send it again, unchanged, when retrying. A retry returns the first result instead of moving money twice.
